WHAT: Combine check + increment in one atomic DB operation using Prisma updateMany with a WHERE clause
HOW:
```ts
const result = await prisma.user.updateMany({
  where: { id: userId, monthlySearches: { lt: limit } },
  data: { monthlySearches: { increment: 1 } }
});
if (result.count === 0) return Response.json({ error: 'Limit reached' }, { status: 429 });
```
WHY: Separate check + increment allows two concurrent requests to both pass the check before either increments — classic TOCTOU race. The updateMany WHERE pattern makes it atomic at the DB level.
GOTCHA: Works with Prisma + Postgres/SQLite. More robust than transactions for simple increment-with-guard patterns.
